'''''Dreams of Soil''''' was a massive explorer [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that contained an entire artificial ecosystem. Piloted by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], ''Dreams of Soil'' featured forests, lakes, and a wide variety of plants and animals within its ecosystem.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Starship Ecology}}</ref>
